feeds.title: North Brisbane Trees Blog
feeds.description: North Brisbane Trees are a team experts in tree removal and are based out of Samford in Brisbane North. We have been providing first rate Arborist services, tree removal and tree lopping services. We promise a reliable, prompt, professional, expert & affordable tree service - every time! Learn about bush fire, tree loppoing, tree pruning, and more.

feeds.title: Porter Designs Blog
feeds.description: Eva can capture what is important to you and showcase it through her design so that you feel connected with your garden design on an emotional level. The purpose of Porter Designs is to serve people by designing a fulfilling life in the landscape and to share by supporting our community. Read through articles about garden design and keep up with the news and recent happenings at Porter Designs.

feeds.title: SubTropical Queensland Open Garden Blog
feeds.description: Explore our journey as gardeners in this blog. A one-acre Sub Tropical garden situated just east of Brisbane. We have opened our garden to the public for 18 years. We open in November to aid a specific charity. Judy and I are 'plants-people' and cannot resist buying something rare that we do not have. It has been very hard gardening as we seem to be in a severe drought most years.

feeds.title: Jerry Coleby Williams
feeds.description: Inspired by his family of gardeners and farmers Jerry has been gardening since the age of four. Jerry remains a 'horticultural schizophrenic' equally at home sipping tea in a high Victorian conservatory or manuring an allotment. Learn about ecotypes, gardening, Jerry's work, and more.

feeds.title: Brookfield Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Brookfield Gardens is nestled amongst a natural backdrop of bushland. A collection of botanically inspired destinations, making up one of Brisbane's premier retail experiences for designers, homemakers and gardeners. At the very heart of our philosophy is a dedication to plants and an authentic love of gardening. Enjoy our articles and get gardening advice.

feeds.title: Brisbane Edible Gardening
feeds.description: We are a grassroots movement. Our aim is to provide reliable edible gardening advice to everyone and especially to those who have busy lives and young families but still want to grow their own food.We want to share our experience to help everyone successfully grow, at least some, of their own food. We provide community education and work with schools and community gardens, providing plants and advice for edible gardening success. heck out our blog for gardening tips.

feeds.title: Greater Brisbane Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Greater Brisbane Gardens is a professional company providing a range of gardening services across Brisbane including garden maintenance, landscape design, and horticultural work. We are a team of passionate horticulturists and designers that started tending to plants and outdoor spaces as Greater Brisbane Gardens in 2010. Know about gardens to visit in Brisbane, upcoming events, feature tress, and more.

feeds.title: Love of Dirt » Organic Gardening Tips
feeds.description: Meet Nicki, who specializes in helping individuals grow their own food. Nicki's blog focuses on various aspects of backyard food cultivation. The goal is to share Nicki's personal journey of growing food for her family while inspiring others to embark on a similar path. If you're seeking assistance to start or improve your kitchen garden, you're welcome to join the community inside Dirt Lovers.
